en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town taken from near a railway line. Curved train tracks and railway signals run through the foreground, alongside small industrial structures and a tall factory chimney. Behind a row of trees stands a series of multi‑storey residential and institutional buildings with steep tiled roofs and ornate façades. Several church towers with crosses dominate the skyline, including a prominent onion‑domed tower on the right that crowns a hilltop church or monastery. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century Central European town combining rail infrastructure, industry, and historic religious architecture.
